answer.rationale: Competitive pricing pressure on SMB segment demands immediate response. Memory_73 confirms targeted promotional pricing is effective for price-sensitive SMBs with strong acquisition and revenue lift. A small_guarded_test allows rapid deployment to at-risk accounts while preserving ability to pivot. Pairing with memory_86 (simplified onboarding) and memory_91 (activation messaging) creates a retention bundle—the pricing move addresses acquisition risk while proven activation levers improve durability post-acquisition. This avoids over-committing to broad discounting and maintains focus on sustainable qualified revenue. Flagged: promotional pricing can degrade unit economics if not carefully segmented; uncertainty preserved by limiting scale initially and monitoring cohort quality metrics before broader rollout. Enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) is secondary—valuable but longer-cycle and doesn't address immediate churn threat.
